relations.subject: Ajahn Brahm
relations.evidence: Ordained in 1974, he trained in the Thai Forest Tradition of Theravada Buddhism under his teacher Ajahn Chah.

relations.subject: Ajahn Brahm
relations.evidence: He won a scholarship to study theoretical physics at Emmanuel College, University of Cambridge in the late 1960s.

relations.subject: Ajahn Brahm
relations.evidence: Ajahn Brahm was sent to Perth by Ajahn Chah in 1983 to assist Ajahn Jagaro in teaching duties.

relations.subject: Ajahn Brahm
relations.evidence: Currently, Ajahn Brahm is the abbot of Bodhinyana Monastery in Serpentine, Western Australia

relations.subject: Ajahn Brahm
relations.evidence: On 22 October 2009, Ajahn Brahm, along with Bhante Sujato, facilitated an ordination ceremony for bhikkhunis
